ideas.pitch: A clinical-grade triage web application with rPPG contactless heart rate sensing and localized multilingual symptom parsing for rural health workers.
ideas.problem_statement: Medical & HealthTech track: bridging the gap in preliminary diagnostics and triage access for under-resourced or non-English speaking patient populations.
ideas.title: MediTriage Multilingual Health Platform
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines a working hardware-independent biometric feature (rPPG via web camera) with localized care, matching patterns from successful health hackathon entries like mediscan-ai and SAGACITY.

ideas.pitch: An investigative dashboard that uncovers illicit transaction topologies in financial networks using graph intelligence and explainable machine learning.
ideas.problem_statement: FinTech track: mitigating sophisticated money laundering techniques and compliance failures in digital asset and fiat transaction rails.
ideas.title: GraphGuard AML Risk Detection
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the high-complexity engineering pattern seen in Bito by providing transparent, explainable feature attribution instead of a black-box risk score.

ideas.pitch: A computer vision platform that ingests video footage of sports batting motions, parses joint vectors via MediaPipe, and scores biomechanical alignment.
ideas.problem_statement: Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning track: applying real-time pose estimation and automated classification models to physical skill training.
ideas.title: KinematicCricket Form Analyzer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages robust client-side ML pipelines that run entirely in the browser, matching the technical execution of CricketVision_AI.

ideas.pitch: An automated routing and scheduling platform that groups isolated seniors into nearby social outings while matching them with verified volunteer drivers.
ideas.problem_statement: Smart Cities & Social Impact track: combating elderly isolation and solving urban last-mile mobility barriers for community engagement.
ideas.title: ElderLink Community Outreach
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses clear measurable social impact with a workflow that judges can instantly understand and appreciate, replicating the Outreach grand prize formula.

ideas.pitch: An interactive clinical simulation tool where medical students interview an LLM-driven patient and practice procedural protocols tracked via computer vision.
ideas.problem_statement: Human-AI & Assistive Technology track: creating interactive, reliable simulation environments for high-stakes professional training and objective scoring.
ideas.title: MedSim OSCE Evaluator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines multi-modal inputs (vision pose tracking + conversational LLM evaluation) into a comprehensive rubric dashboard, following the design of Clinical-Simulator.
